_comment: MLV-App's values for the fleet doctrine outbox. Data only: tools/coordination/doctrine_outbox.py is the config-driven shared file offered as the candidate for the bus's tools/factory/doctrine_outbox.py (adoption is pending the bus steward, see the handoff card in doctrine-outbox/). Once the bus holds it, each project pins a reviewed bus SHA in factory-pins/factory-pins.json and runs it through factory-pins/pin-runner.py with --config, and, once its config sets `tool_pin`, the installed hook and the ref check use the pin (release OUTBOX-PIN-AWARE-TOOL-AT-REF-1); without `tool_pin` they read tool_rel, so this repo KEEPS its local copy and sets no `tool_pin` until the bus holds the file. It is never edited here for a project value. The tool finds this file at the repo root (or via --config / $DOCTRINE_OUTBOX_CONFIG).
